Title: 491008-2026: France – Construction work – Construction work for the new Scène de Musiques Actuelles (SMAC) in Angers (49)
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a music/cultural venue (SMAC) corresponds to the type of music theatre/concert hall/large cultural buildings that is of interest for sbp. As the project is in France and not in the DACH region, it has slightly lower priority.
titel: Construction work for the new venue for contemporary music in Angers
kurzbeschreibung: New construction of a music events venue in Angers with several fit-out and shell construction lots.
umfang: New construction of a Scène de Musiques Actuelles (SMAC) in Angers as a building project with several specialist lots. Mentioned are, among others, earthworks and outdoor facilities, special foundations and shell construction, mullion-and-transom facades and glazed elements, interior fit-out with wooden stands and furniture, suspended ceilings, lifts, HVAC, strong and weak current, stage machinery in steel construction as well as audiovisual and stage lighting. Total construction time expected to be 23 months including 1 month of preparation. Specific areas, spans or capacities are not stated.
leistungen: Construction services in several lots; in particular shell construction with special foundations, facades, interior fit-out, technical building services, stage steelwork and stage machinery. No planning services are tendered.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Cultural building construction is generally of interest for sbp, especially for architecturally sophisticated event buildings.
• However, the notice concerns pure construction execution in specialist lots and no structural or planning services.
• There is some connection to sbp via shell construction, facades and stage steelwork, but without any discernible planning share.
• No information on special spans, innovative structures or lightweight design concepts.
• Project volume is moderate at around 11 million EUR, but only of limited strategic relevance for sbp.
honorar_erklaerung: No planning services and no fee for engineering services stated; construction services in specialist lots are tendered.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Proof of professional liability and ten-year liability insurance; turnover of the last 3 years for comparable services; extract from the commercial register; human, material and technical resources; at least 5 meaningful references from the last 5 years with client, location, construction costs, dates, usable floor area, type of intervention and exact service; relevant professional qualification certificates appropriate to the respective lot.
zuschlagskriterien: Price 55 %, technical quality 40 %, environmental and social value 5 %
auftraggeber: Alter Public acting in the name and on behalf of the City of Angers, 48 C Bd Foch - BP 80110, 49101 Angers cedex 02, France, E-Mail: l.thomas@anjouloiterritoire.fr, Tel.: 0241182121, Website: https://www.achatpublic.com/sdm/ent/gen/ent_detail.do?PCSLID=CSL_2026_1dBgHyqOXR
notes: Amendment notice: tender deadline for all lots extended from 24.07.2026 to 30.07.2026, 12:00. Total estimated contract value excluding VAT 11030917 EUR. Several lots are not fully included in the extract; visible are, among others, lots 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19 and 20. Additional optional services only for lot 16. Prices are variable; in part social performance clauses.
